acceptedInterpretation: The request is a pure migration: move the existing, already working proof-or-stop-graph source into this repository as packages/graph and expose it through a new top-level CLI command named graph, without rewriting the web shell or altering graph, search or playback behavior. The competing reading that was rejected is a reimplementation of a story visualizer inside packages/main, which the user did not ask for and which the scope boundary explicitly excludes. The user also settled two sub-questions directly: the code lands in a new packages/graph subpackage rather than inside packages/main or as an external npm dependency, and the vendored browser bundles stay out of source as dependency build output.
notes: No residual ambiguity. The user answered the placement question and the command-name question explicitly, and pushed back on the vendored-bundle question as having an obvious answer. Scope boundary recorded in scope-boundary.json with 7 allowed and 6 excluded entries.
